about:
# DontDownloadSFX
Prevents SFX downloads by tricking the game into thinking you already have them.

This [Geode mod](https://geode-sdk.org) is licensed under LGPLv2. To report bugs or get help with using my mods, press the Discord button in the lower left corner.
changelog:
# DontDownloadSFX Changelog
## v1.0.1
- Adjustments on how aggresively the mod prevents SFX downloads.
  - Incidentally, this mod no longer prevents SFX downloads when inside the level editor. (Hopefully, anyhow.)
## v1.0.0
- Initial release (on Codeberg).
